name: International Benchmarking Collaboration for Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy
description: An international collaboration establishing standardized outcome measures to compare and benchmark care and outcomes for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy across centers.
reputation: Widely recognized among perinatal research networks for standardizing outcome definitions, though adoption varies by region and center.
notes: Not an ML benchmark — intended for inter‑center clinical benchmarking; heterogeneous data definitions and collection practices across sites, privacy and small-sample issues for rare outcomes, potential center-level confounding.
